scope: Assistant visual inspection of final ordinary junctions, retained bridge, linked-courts mosaic, network overlay and desktop/mobile reader. Cross-market and roadside final mosaics are byte-identical to the inspected finishing-development versions.
findings: Both new junctions are continuous T joins with no unnecessary parallel strips or misleading separated contacts.
Existing bridge approaches and deck remain continuous; ordinary shortcut adds no bridge or crossing ownership rows.
Town/common mosaic retains connected orthogonal streets and populated buildings; mosaic headers are presentation separators, not terrain gaps.
Network overlay distinguishes gold baseline, green connection and blue waterways; endpoint labels remain readable.
Desktop and mobile reader layouts remain legible with navigation and copy controls.
